mapper.select: SELECT fire_id AS fireId, fire_damage_area AS fireDamageArea, fire_end_time AS fireEndTime, fire_cause AS fireCause, fire_loc_village AS fireLocVillage, fire_start_time AS fireStartTime, IF(fire_expose_yn = 'Y', 1, 0) AS isVisible FROM forest_fire_information WHERE fire_start_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) ORDER BY fire_start_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forest_fire_information ( fire_id, fire_damage_area, fire_end_time, fire_cause, fire_loc_village, fire_start_time, fire_expose_yn ) VALUES ( #{fireId}, #{fireDamageArea}, #{fireEndTime}, #{fireCause}, #{fireLocVillage}, #{fireStartTime}, 'Y' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fire_damage_area = VALUES(fire_damage_area), fire_end_time = VALUES(fire_end_time), fire_cause = VALUES(fire_cause), fire_loc_village = VALUES(fire_loc_village), fire_start_time = VALUES(fire_start_time)

INSERT INTO forest_fire_risk ( anal_date, do_name, avg_index, max_index, min_index, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{analDate}, #{doName}, #{avgIndex}, #{maxIndex}, #{minIndex}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_index = VALUES(avg_index), max_index = VALUES(max_index), min_index = VALUES(min_index)
mapper.select: SELECT anal_date AS analDate, do_name AS doName, avg_index AS avgIndex, max_index AS maxIndex, min_index AS minIndex FROM forest_fire_risk ORDER BY anal_date DESC, reg_dt DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO earthquake_event ( seq, lat, lon, loc, rem, tm_fc, msc, mt, expose_yn ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{lat}, #{lon}, #{loc}, #{rem}, #{tmFc}, #{msc}, #{mt}, 'Y' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE loc = VALUES(loc), mt = VALUES(mt), rem = VALUES(rem);
mapper.select: SELECT seq, lat, lon, loc, rem, tm_fc AS tmFc, mt, msc, IF(expose_yn = 'Y', 1, 0) AS isVisible FROM earthquake_event WHERE STR_TO_DATE(tm_fc, '%Y%m%d%H%i') >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) ORDER BY tm_fc DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO typhoon_info ( typhoon_year, typhoon_no, typhoon_name, typhoon_name_desc, typhoon_active_yn, typhoon_first_location ) VALUES ( #{typhoonYear}, #{typhoonNo}, #{typhoonName}, #{typhoonNameDesc}, #{typhoonActiveYn}, #{typhoonFirstLocation} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE typhoon_active_yn = VALUES(typhoon_active_yn), typhoon_name_desc = VALUES(typhoon_name_desc);
mapper.select: SELECT i.typhoon_year AS typhoonYear, i.typhoon_no AS typhoonNo, i.typhoon_name AS typhoonName, i.typhoon_active_yn AS typhoonActiveYn, t.typhoon_analysis_datetime AS typhoonAnalysisDatetime, t.typhoon_lat AS typhoonLat, t.typhoon_lon AS typhoonLon, t.typhoon_location AS typhoonLocation, t.typhoon_max_wind_speed AS typhoonMaxWindSpeed FROM typhoon_info i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM typhoon_track WHERE (typhoon_year, typhoon_no, typhoon_report_no) IN ( SELECT typhoon_year, typhoon_no, MAX(typhoon_report_no) FROM typhoon_track GROUP BY typhoon_year, typhoon_no ) ) t ON i.typhoon_year = t.typhoon_year AND i.typhoon_no = t.typhoon_no ORDER BY i.typhoon_year DESC, i.typhoon_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO typhoon_track ( typhoon_year, typhoon_no, typhoon_analysis_datetime, typhoon_lat, typhoon_lon, typhoon_move_speed, typhoon_central_pressure, typhoon_max_wind_speed, typhoon_radius_15ms, typhoon_radius_25ms, typhoon_location, typhoon_report_no ) VALUES ( #{typhoonYear}, #{typhoonNo}, #{typhoonAnalysisDatetime}, #{typhoonLat}, #{typhoonLon}, #{typhoonMoveSpeed}, #{typhoonCentralPressure}, #{typhoonMaxWindSpeed}, #{typhoonRadius15ms}, #{typhoonRadius25ms}, #{typhoonLocation}, #{typhoonReportNo} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE typhoon_analysis_datetime = VALUES(typhoon_analysis_datetime), typhoon_lat = VALUES(typhoon_lat), typhoon_lon = VALUES(typhoon_lon), typhoon_move_speed = VALUES(typhoon_move_speed), typhoon_central_pressure = VALUES(typhoon_central_pressure), typhoon_max_wind_speed = VALUES(typhoon_max_wind_speed), typhoon_radius_15ms = VALUES(typhoon_radius_15ms), typhoon_radius_25ms = VALUES(typhoon_radius_25ms), typhoon_location = VALUES(typhoon_location);
INSERT INTO lnld_forecast_info ( lnld_frcst_nm, sgg_nm, predc_anls_dt, data_std_dt, use_yn, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{lnldFrcstNm}, #{sggNm}, #{predcAnlsDt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT lnld_frcst_nm AS lnldFrcstNm, sgg_nm AS sggNm, predc_anls_dt AS predcAnlsDt FROM ( SELECT lnld_frcst_nm, sgg_nm, predc_anls_dt, -- 지역(sgg_nm)별로 그룹화해서 가장 최신 발령 일시만 가져옴 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY sgg_nm ORDER BY predc_anls_dt DESC) as rn FROM lnld_forecast_info WHERE use_yn = 'Y' -- 1. 산사태 데이터만 확실히 필터링 (필드값이 있을 때만) AND lnld_frcst_nm IS NOT NULL AND sgg_nm IS NOT NULL -- 2. (선택사항) 특정 기간 내 데이터만 보고 싶다면 추가 -- AND reg_dt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 -- 각 지역별 최신 데이터 1개씩만 선택 ORDER BY t.predc_anls_dt DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kma_weather_report ( tm_fc, tm_seq, area_code, warn_var, stn_id, area_name, warn_stress, start_time, end_time, type, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{tmFc}, #{tmSeq}, #{areaCode}, #{warnVar}, #{stnId}, #{areaName}, #{warnStress}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{type}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE area_name = VALUES(area_name), warn_stress = VALUES(warn_stress), start_time = VALUES(start_time), end_time = VALUES(end_time), type = VALUES(type), warn_var = VALUES(warn_var)
mapper.select:
SELECT id, tm_fc AS tmFc, tm_seq AS tmSeq, area_code AS areaCode, warn_var AS warnVar, stn_id AS stnId, area_name AS areaName, warn_stress AS warnStress, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, type,
IF(expose_yn = 'Y', 1, 0) AS isVisible FROM kma_weather_report WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY tm_fc DESC, tm_seq DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO water_level_info ( obs_cd, obs_nm, bbsn_nm, mng_org, obs_time, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{obsCd}, #{obsNm}, #{bbsnNm}, #{mngOrg}, #{obsTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE obs_nm = VALUES(obs_nm), bbsn_nm = VALUES(bbsn_nm), mng_org = VALUES(mng_org)
mapper.select: SELECT obs_cd AS obsCd, obs_nm AS obsNm, bbsn_nm AS bbsnNm, mng_org AS mngOrg, obs_time AS obsTime, water_level AS waterLevel FROM water_level_info ORDER BY obs_time DESC
